# Tabs

Swap panels in place. Not for moving between pages; that is jump-nav.

In `library/components/tabs/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

## ARIA

- **the strip** — `role=tablist` `aria-label`
- **each tab** — `role=tab` `aria-selected` `aria-controls` `tabindex`
- **each panel** — `role=tabpanel` `aria-labelledby` `tabindex=0`

## Keyboard

- `ArrowLeft / ArrowRight` — move and select, since the panels are already in the DOM
- `Home / End` — first / last tab
- `Tab` — one stop for the strip, then into the panel

**States:** selected, disabled

## Goes wrong when

- every tab at tabindex=0, so the strip is as many stops as it has tabs
- unselected panels hidden with opacity, which hides them from nobody — their links are still stops
- no tabindex on the panel, so Tab steps over it and its name is never read
- links wearing role=tab, announcing as a widget while aria-controls names panels nobody built

**API:** `AC.createTabs(root, options) -> { select, selected, tabs, panels, destroy }`

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.1 2.1.1 2.4.3 2.4.7 2.5.8 4.1.2 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/) · see also `jump-nav`, `disclosure`, `chip-toggle`
